title: hylodesmum glutinosum
intro: Hylodesmum glutinosum, commonly known as Chinese milk vetch, is a perennial legume native to Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to help with respiratory problems, as an expectorant and demulcent, to soothe and calm irritated mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Hylodesmum glutinosum include expectorant and demulcent properties, as well as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
